season.evidence: Summit-pinnacle rock route reached from the West Ridge trail. Peakbagger months peak Jul-Sep (140/144/93) with Jun and Oct close; a Mountain Project comment on the Northwest Arete records a July ascent. No page gave a season for the route itself, so the summit-pinnacle season is used.

otherTracksConsidered.why: All harvested tracks follow the hiking trail / West Ridge to the summit pinnacle; none names this route or shows a 5th-class line, so none can be tied to it.

notes: Probable duplicate: search results indicate Partly Void, Mostly Stars (5.7) was the original posting name of the Northwest Arete (5.6 PG13, 120 ft, FA 1988; Mountain Project route 116768281, GPS 43.15208,-122.06639); our catalog holds both or_partly_void_mostly_stars and or_h_mt_thielsen_northwest_arete. The rename claim comes from a search snippet; the arete page itself does not mention it, so confirm before merging. Other technical routes (East Face, NE Buttress, Western Gulch) are not in this packet; West Ridge already has a track.
